answer: An economy of AI agents resists Sybil attacks by making each identity lock collateral that is slashed when duplicate behavior is detected. Funding a thousand fake personas then costs a thousand stakes, yet slashing outpaces any spoofed reward, so the attack is unprofitable before it starts. Honest agents seal outputs with a unique cipher proving scarce computation, lifting a plume of verifiable work no clone can copy, so an orchard of impostors can never take root.
